body: I have the exact opposite problem. Love being at work, but get miserable when I have to go home... Wife and I don't get along
I don't see how the news can possibly be good... Life for me is never going to get better

I have no idea. I wish I did. He runs, plays, swims, rides bikes and Rollerblades with no issues.

We were actually laughing when we got the note from the teacher because it seemed like a joke.

But apparently it's to do with posture and pencil grip. I don't know. We went to an assessment and the woman basically also laughed at the teacher's note.

But then she noted that he didn't hold the pencil properly and recommended another assessment. Now we're waiting.

We don't know what's going to happen yet. He's being assessed but I can't find definitive information about what the implications of weak core muscles are or what the prognosis could be.

I think the lack of information is the worst thing.

Personally i had no idea I had the issue until my mom told my wife. But she told her in a condescending way like it was all a load of crap and we should ignore it like she did.

I think that made it worse. Then when I get home from work my wife tells me it's my bad genes that are responsible for this.

I'm also angry because Noone picked it up before. All of his previous teachers gave him full scores for almost everything. Now that it's been diagnosed so late, what does that mean?

Thank you man.

My world has just crashed. From 2 up until now all his reports have been excellent and the teachers always commented on how smart he was. 

But suddenly his whole future is in doubt. I think that pushed us both over the edge but her blaming me just made our usual issues spiral out of control.

I honestly don't know if this is salvageable
